DSH_WORKSURFACE_CLI.purpose: Invoke WorkSurface help and exact Runtime-authorized emit argv even when the profile bin directory is absent from PATH.

DSH_WORKSURFACE_ROOT.purpose: Locate Surface and Orchestrate authoring directories.

DSH_SURFACE_ID.purpose: Identify the one Surface bound to the current DSH Session.

DSH_SURFACE_DIR.purpose: Read and maintain the current Surface files.

DSH_WORKSURFACE_VIEW_DIR.purpose: Read turn-brief.json plus the current Turn's filtered input details and Event Contracts.

ws.purpose: Discover authoring and coordination help; admit authoring, inspect Surfaces, request host execution or recovery, and submit Turn-authorized events.

adapterTransport.purpose: Private host transport locator. Supplied by the adapter and consumed automatically by the CLI; never a business input or model-authored authority.
